name: Pixies vs Pirates

features.name: xWays Mystery Chests
features.description: Reveal symbol stacks for more ways.

review:
A six-reel fantasy battle pairing xNudge wilds with xWays Mystery Chests. Wilds slide into view gaining +1 per step, while chests reveal stacks of symbols to add ways.

Three or more scatters start Battle Rounds Freespins, where every reel is fully expanded for 11,664 ways and the wild multipliers can climb much higher. High volatility, 11,907x max, 95.91% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
